purpose: Post-study descriptive figures and a fixed-parameter numerical horizon sweep; no replacement of the two original primary comparisons

selected_window.first_action: response to known initial Meander mode

primary_trajectory_figures.uncertainty: Descriptive pointwise crossed bootstrap of whole simulator seed tables and whole paths; calibration and selected settings held fixed
primary_trajectory_figures.claim: No new confirmatory superiority or equivalence claim

geometry.quantity: delta_t = dist(mean_{s<=t} u(p_s, ell_s), S(conv{ell_1,...,ell_t})) in the fixed normalized training game
geometry.target: Full response target including responses on all mixtures in the realized hull, checked by full-target support LPs
geometry.primary_paths: All 50 locked primary paths; logarithmic, regular and hull/phase-change checkpoints
geometry.fixed_target_panel: Retrospective distance to each path's final full target S(Q_T), never passed to learners
geometry.zero_handling: Display numerical resolution and censored near-zero values explicitly; no arbitrary epsilon substitution for fitted slopes
geometry.reference_rate: T^-1/2 for realized opponent dimension q<=2; a reference upper-rate exponent, not a prediction of exact finite-sample slope

terminal_horizon_sweep.schedule: Each horizon is separately announced to the learners; curriculum phases and original attacker/Hedge schedules scale with that horizon
terminal_horizon_sweep.interpretation: Descriptive comparison of a fixed experiment family, not prefixes of one run or proof of a worst-case exponent
terminal_horizon_sweep.uncertainty: Whole-path variability conditional on fixed calibration; no simulator-seed uncertainty for deterministic calibrated vector geometry

reproducibility: Publish compact trajectory inputs, configurations, source/input hashes, software versions, numerical geometry diagnostics and RU/EN PNG/PDF figures
